fixed.explanation: parseRawCookie sets cookie.expires from both Expires and Max-Age in order, so the last one wins. Track Max-Age separately and apply it after the loop so it takes precedence. Also only accept Max-Age values matching /^-?[0-9]+$/.

query.intent: Set-Cookie header parsing in the API request context cookie jar: parsing of Max-Age and Expires attributes into the cookie's expires value. Should track Max-Age separately so it takes precedence over Expires regardless of order, and ignore Max-Age values not matching /^-?[0-9]+$/.
query.symptom: Cookie with Max-Age followed by a past Expires is stored as expired and not sent, and malformed Max-Age values like "10abc" or empty are parsed as numbers instead of ignored.
